subject.title: Converge dog plugin execution and outcome authority
subject.author: blairsilverberg

action_plan.summary: Carry PR #4502's valid deterministic run.sh-before-AI intent forward on current main by collapsing daemon auto dispatch, gt plugin run, gt dog dispatch, dog assignment, cooldown/retry, receipt/history, exit-10 handoff, output bounds, and runner env trust into one plugin.Runtime contract using existing plugin Recorder authority and dog AssignWorkIfIdle/ClearWorkIfMatches. Do not layer another receipt system or shell-only bypass.

artifacts.summary: Replacement target semantics: status=merge-ready, priority=p1, kind=bug. Original PR #4502 is closed status/review-failed and is not the merge target.

Original PR #4502 by blairsilverberg/furiosa is closed with labels kind/bug priority/p1 status/review-failed, head 59505deed8fc1b12d1be82d31194921060651f5a, base 2bd80946ddf1f3314d880c68800f44205a0a5f5e, no reviews, and Sheriff comment rejecting split authority/unbounded env/non-atomic assignment while preserving valid run.sh-before-AI intent.

Bead notes record completed 15 research legs R01-R15 and approving pre-reviews P06/P07/P08/P10/P11, with P01/P04 blockers resolved by suppressing record-run under GT_PLUGIN_RUNNER_ACTIVE and using exact canonical Beads/Dolt env.
Current-main replacement head db4436e6c54ddd5679fba0f92ccaa8e868e96b45 rebased on upstream/main 649b832b. Contributor-intent commits reference PR #4502 and co-author furiosa <blair@humcapital.com>.
Focused plugin runtime, dog assignment, CLI dispatch, daemon handler, whitespace, and build checks passed with CGO_ENABLED=0 where needed.

Broad CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -timeout=10m ./... was attempted and failed in unrelated/environment-sensitive packages: internal/cmd Dolt connection timeout, internal/config copilot preset expectation, internal/doctor/doltserver, internal/nudge timing, and internal/tmux local dialog/coreutils expectations.
gt-pr-sheriff-check --merge-gate passed with merge_path_allowed=true and verdict=merge_replacement.

Approved cleanup-first convergence: shared plugin runtime, run.sh before dog/AI, existing recorder/cooldown labels, retryable failures out of cooldown, bounded output/record requests, AssignWorkIfIdle/ClearWorkIfMatches.

Approved outcomes/receipt authority: Runtime.Execute records only after script/dispatch result, no launch-success receipts, failure/no-dog retryable and not cooldown-counted, script record-run requests filtered into runner authority.

Approved security/containment: allowlisted env, bounded output and runner record file, receipt output omission, run.sh regular-file validation, runner record-run suppression; nonblocking note that exit-10 dog mail intentionally includes bounded output tail.

Approved dog assignment/dispatch: atomic AssignWorkIfIdle, timestamped ClearWorkIfMatches on session/mail/context failures, create/target behavior, in-flight duplicate prevention, retryable no-dog, and CLI/daemon convergence.

Approved verification/evidence readiness: focused regressions cover success/failure/timeout/exit10/manual/assignment/security, docs align, and attribution for PR #4502/blairsilverberg is present on contributor-derived commits.
PR #4502 valid intent: deterministic plugin run.sh work must execute before any AI dog step, but original head split execution authority and was rejected.
Replacement must be based on current upstream/main and avoid carrying stale split runner/daemon code directly.
A single Runtime.Execute should own daemon, manual plugin run, and dog dispatch execution to remove shell-only bypasses and divergent receipt timing.
Existing plugin Recorder/history from gt-plughist-20260714 should remain authoritative; do not layer another receipt system.
Cooldown gates must count only explicitly counted success/skipped legacy or success-style receipts; failure/no-dog/dispatch/timeout must be visible retryable records.
Exit code 10 is the only script path that requests an AI dog follow-up after run.sh completes; the dog prompt must say run.sh already ran and must not be rerun.
Dog assignment must use atomic AssignWorkIfIdle and clear only the exact timestamped assignment on later session/mail/context failure.
gt plugin run and gt dog dispatch must route through the same runtime as daemon auto dispatch, with manual dispatch creating a dog only if dog work is needed.
Runner environment should be a minimal allowlist with canonical Beads/Dolt endpoint variables and no inherited secrets such as GT_DOLT_DATA or arbitrary parent env.
Script stdout/stderr must be bounded; receipts should omit raw script output while exit-10 dog mail may include only bounded fenced output tail.
run.sh calls to gt plugin record-run under the runner should not create duplicate receipts; they should become bounded runner record requests folded into the one authoritative outcome.
In-flight plugin dog work should prevent duplicate dispatch and script reruns without converting dispatch/no-dog failures into cooldown-hiding successes.
Docs and plugin templates must remove manual shell bypass instructions and document the shared runtime contract.
Replacement carrying PR #4502 intent must preserve blairsilverberg/furiosa attribution with PR refs and co-author trailers where contributor intent/code is carried.
Final merge path requires 15 research legs, 5 approving pre-reviews, 5 final-head reviews, focused verification, blocker scan, attribution, and gt-pr-sheriff-check --merge-gate.
Approved revised plan after resolving earlier duplicate record-run blocker: suppress record-run under GT_PLUGIN_RUNNER_ACTIVE and fold script intent into runner authority.
Approved revised runner env plan: exact canonical Beads/Dolt env and bounded allowlisted PATH rather than inherited environment prefixes.
Approved shared Runtime.Execute convergence across daemon, dog dispatch, and CLI/manual execution.
Approved assignment/dispatch plan using AssignWorkIfIdle, ClearWorkIfMatches, retryable no-dog/dispatch failures, and exit-10 handoff.
Approved cleanup-first replacement and evidence path with PR #4502 attribution and focused success/failure/timeout/exit10/manual/assignment/security regressions.

research_legs.summary: PR #4502 valid intent is run.sh before AI, but original split authority and was rejected.
Replacement must be current-main based and not carry stale split paths.
Use one Runtime.Execute for daemon, CLI, and dog dispatch.
Coordinate with existing plugin Recorder/history rather than layering another receipt system.
Retryable failure/no-dog/dispatch/timeout receipts must not close cooldown.
Exit 10 requests dog follow-up after run.sh; dog must not rerun run.sh.
Atomic AssignWorkIfIdle and timestamped ClearWorkIfMatches are required.
gt plugin run and gt dog dispatch should share daemon runtime behavior.
Minimal allowlisted env and canonical Dolt endpoint variables are required.
Bound output and omit raw script output from receipts.
Script record-run should become a bounded runner request, not a second receipt.
Prevent duplicate plugin dispatch and script rerun while work is in flight.
Docs/templates must remove manual run bypasses and describe shared runtime.
Preserve blairsilverberg/furiosa attribution for carried PR #4502 code or intent.
Need 15+5+5, verification, attribution, blocker scan, and checker merge gate.

cleanup_first.rationale: The replacement removes split daemon/manual/dog execution authority by routing all plugin execution through one Runtime.Execute contract and existing Recorder/history authority. It removes shell-only bypass instructions, avoids a second receipt system, and uses existing dog assignment primitives rather than adding workaround layers.

attribution.required_reason: Replacement preserves accepted intent and some contributor-authored documentation/runtime contract from PR #4502 by blairsilverberg/furiosa.

blocker_scan.summary: Original PR #4502 remains closed/review-failed due split authority, pre-execution success receipts, non-atomic assignment, unbounded/untrusted environment, stale base, and no reviews. Replacement head db4436e6c resolves those blockers through shared runtime, existing Recorder authority, retryable failure semantics, atomic assignment, bounded env/output, focused regressions, and final-head review approvals. Broad local suite failures are environment/baseline-sensitive outside touched scope and are recorded as a separate attempted verification artifact, not as a passing gate.

final.reason: Original PR #4502 is closed/review-failed and not mergeable as-is. The current-main replacement passes 15 research legs, 5 approving pre-implementation reviews, 5 approving final-head post-implementation reviews, cleanup-first convergence, attribution, blocker scan, focused verification, and build gates.
required_actions: Do not close PR #4502 as superseded until the replacement lands with attribution evidence; PR #4502 is already closed as review-failed by Sheriff.
